heroDescription: Reiki and Tambour Unité sessions in a calm, sacred space — in person on the South Shore or at a distance, wherever you are.
aboutTitle: A space to slow down and listen
aboutDescription1: I'm Tania, a Reiki practitioner based in Saint-Hubert on Montreal's South Shore. My practice is built on presence: creating a quiet, unhurried space where your body can release what it no longer needs to carry.
aboutDescription2: Each session blends traditional Usui Reiki with the grounding rhythm of the Tambour Unité, and may include crystals, pendulum work, or sound — always guided by what you need in the moment.
reikiTitle: Universal life energy, guided by intention
reikiDescription: Reiki is a gentle Japanese energy practice developed by Dr. Mikao Usui in the early 20th century. The practitioner channels universal life energy through light touch or at a distance, supporting the body's own capacity to restore balance.
strengthensHealingResponse: Strengthens the body's natural healing response
lastingCalmClarity: Creates a lasting sense of calm and clarity
reikiDisclaimer: Reiki is a complementary practice. It supports — and never replaces — medical or psychological care.
packagesIntro: All sessions are 90 minutes unless noted. A $50 non-refundable deposit reserves your time.
whatToExpect: What should I expect in a session?
faqSessionDescription: You remain fully clothed and rest on a massage table or chair while I work with light touch or hands hovering above the body. Most people feel deep warmth, heaviness, or a sense of drifting.
faqDistanceDescription: Energy is not limited by space. We agree on a time, and you rest comfortably at home while I hold the session remotely. Afterwards we talk through what came up.
faqRapeDescription: Rapé is a traditional Amazonian snuff offered as an optional grounding element before or after your session. It adds $25 and is always by choice.
faqCancellationDescription: The $50 deposit is non-refundable. Please give at least 24 hours' notice to reschedule and the deposit will carry over to your new appointment.
testimonial1: I arrived carrying months of tension and left feeling like I could finally breathe. The drum work was unlike anything I had experienced.
testimonial2: Even at a distance I felt warmth in my chest within minutes. I slept better that night than I had in weeks.
testimonial3: Tania creates such a safe, quiet space. The home cleansing left our whole apartment feeling lighter.
step1: Choose your package — sessions and trainings above.
step2: Reserve online — the live calendar shows all available times.
step3: Send your deposit — $50 CAD by Interac e-transfer to keep your spot.
trainingsGiftCardsNote: Trainings, gift cards and home cleansing are arranged by phone or email.
footerDescription: Energy healing with Tania — Saint-Hubert, Montreal & South Shore, and online.
copyrightNotice: Reiki is a complementary practice and does not replace medical care.
